scientific.integrity: The defining exact FedDyn local subproblem and server correction are specialized to full participation and common-Hessian deterministic quadratics. All trajectory identities are derived algebraically, and numerical replay is used only to guard transcription.
limitations: Common symmetric positive-definite Hessian across clients.
Equal client weights, full participation, exact local minimization, and zero stored-gradient initialization from the defining algorithm.
The geometric-mean parameter is minimax for the mean-residual and client-disagreement channels, not for every possible tuning objective.
No claim for client-dependent Hessians, stochastic or inexact local solvers, unequal weighting, or partial participation.

title: FedDyn has an exact geometric-mean regularization balance on common-Hessian quadratics
